name: Mac Pulse
tagline: Monitor your Mac and reclaim storage in one native app
description: Mac Pulse combines live CPU, memory, GPU, disk and network readings with storage browsing, cache review and development project controls. A free native macOS app with local history, menu-bar readouts and no account or app telemetry.
